packet.title: XSLT streaming (design and implementation, two packets)

item.p: Specifications: XSLT 4.0, 18 "Streaming" (xsl:source-document streamable="yes", xsl:merge with streamable sources, xsl:fork, streamable modes and accumulators, burst-mode functions such as fn:snapshot and fn:copy-of) and 19 "Streamability" (postures, sweeps, the streamability rules of each construct, guaranteed streamability, XTSE3430); XSLT 4.0, 27 (the streaming conformance feature).
Unlocks: XT40 streaming 2,932 (tests/strm/ 2,564: sf-, si-, sx- sets; streamable 139; streaming-fallback 6, today run unstreamed).
Replaces: today streamable="yes" runs unstreamed, as a non-streaming processor may (src/xslt_read.c, src/xslt_accumulator.c, supports-streaming false, the driver's streaming-fallback).
7.6a Streamability analysis:

a static pass over the XSLT AST and the lowered XPath that gives each construct its posture and sweep (glossary , ) by XSLT 4.0, 19, and raises XTSE3430 where a construct declared streamable is not guaranteed-streamable;
streamed constructs still run unstreamed, which the suite cannot tell apart: every result, plus the static errors;
the drivers count streaming cases;
supports-streaming stays false until 7.6b.
Owns: new src/xslt_streamability.c and src/xslt_streamability_internal.h.
Done 2026-10-19 (): XT40 streaming cases 2,841 of 2,936 (strm 2,503 of 2,564), 154 of 156 XTSE3430 cases; no pass lost but system-property-013, now not applicable.
7.6b Streamed evaluation:
the XML parser feeds builder events to a receiving task () in place of an arena builder;

the lowering of a guaranteed-streamable mode or source document selects nodes as their events pass: a streamed node is a window of its ancestors, its attributes and its own events, held in allocator memory;
grounded operands (fn:copy-of, fn:snapshot) build small trees through the tree builder;
memory is bounded by the depth and the grounded parts, not by the document;
claims the feature (supports-streaming true).

Owns: new src/evaluator_stream.c and src/xslt_lower_stream.c, the receiving side in src/evaluator_construct.c (single hunks agreed with the evaluator's owners), and a memory test of a 1 GB generated document.

Done 2026-10-19 (): xsl:source-document bodies of motionless instructions and one xsl:for-each over a downward path stream (STREAM, src/evaluator_stream.c, an incremental parse); allocator peak 232 KB at 2.4 MB to 106 MB, but tree-sitter's syntax tree of the whole input remains (3.98 GB at 106 MB, so no 1 GB test); the fallback option in xslt.h; supports-streaming true. XT40 11,797 to 11,804, none lost. Left: accumulators, streamable modes and apply-templates, iterate, fork, merge, aggregates, the principal source, incremental tokenizing of content.

7.6c More streamed shapes (after 7.6b; ): reuse the STREAM machinery, 7.6a's sweeps and the shared evaluator for, in order, apply-templates and streamable modes with position(); accumulators; aggregates over a streamed path; attribute steps at the end of a path; xsl:iterate, xsl:fork, xsl:merge; a streamed principal source. Count the source-document executions and mode runs that stream.

Owns: src/xslt_lower_stream.c, src/evaluator_stream.c, tests/evaluator_stream_test.c; single hunks in src/xpath_lower.c (the lowering override), src/xslt_streamability.c (mode verdicts), src/xslt_lower_template.c, src/evaluator_template.c and the IR.

Done 2026-10-19 (): streamed paths in value-of, copy-of, sequence, for-each, apply-templates, iterate and for-each-group selects (counted, folded, atomized or full windows; a last attribute step); template rules applied node by node with their position; declared but unused accumulators no longer stop streaming; a text bug fixed. XT40 no case changed; streamed source documents 164 to 986; 57 nodes get templates one by one, 600,075 fold. Left: accumulators computed while streaming, xsl:fork, xsl:merge, the streamed principal source (no xslt.h field), template rules with stream points of their own.

7.6d The remaining streamed shapes (after 7.6c; ), in order of value: (a) a streamed principal source, an additive xslt.h field with a record, used by sxml transform, with the CLI's memory at 100 MB before and after; (b) accumulators computed while streaming; (c) xsl:fork, then xsl:merge with streamed inputs; (d) template rules with stream points of their own; (e) avg folding; (f) the IR printer's new fields.

Owns: src/xslt_lower_stream.c, src/evaluator_stream.c, tests/evaluator_stream_test.c, include/sxml/xslt.h (the field), apps/sxml/command_transform.c; single hunks in src/xslt.c, src/xslt_lower.c, src/xslt_lower_template.c, src/xslt_streamability.c, the IR and the XSLT driver.

Done 2026-10-19 (): (a) streamed_source_uri and sxml_xslt_stylesheet_streams_source; sxml transform streams an INPUT file when the initial mode streams: "/" with a for-each over a 100 MB document 673.2 MB to 267.3 MB resident, template rules 658.8 MB (tree) to 267.3 MB; the driver streams the suite's streaming="true" sources. (d) template rules of streamed modes run on open nodes, streamed or grounded (STREAM axis self); built-in rules, apply- templates without select and child-step apply points stream. (e) avg folds as sum and count. (f) done. XT40 none lost. Left: (b) accumulators while streaming, (c) xsl:fork and xsl:merge, and a principal result held whole until it is serialized (the identity keeps memory proportional to its output).

7.6e The last streamed shapes (after 7.6d; ), in order: (a) accumulators computed while streaming: pre-descent and post-descent rules, fn:accumulator-before and -after on streamed nodes, the streamability of accumulator rules (18.2.9); (b) xsl:fork, then xsl:merge with streamed inputs; (c) the principal result delivered as it is produced, through the result writer, so a streamed identity runs in bounded memory end to end; (d) a resolver form that delivers bytes incrementally (additive in processor.h, with a record), so sxml transform does not hold its input. Peak resident memory of sxml transform on a generated 100 MB document before and after.

Owns: src/evaluator_stream.c, src/xslt_lower_stream.c, src/xslt_accumulator.c, tests/evaluator_stream_test.c; single hunks in src/function_library_xslt.c (the row), the IR (sxml_ir_stream_accumulators), src/evaluator_internal.h, src/xslt_streamability.c, src/xslt_lower_template.c, src/xslt_lower_control.c (xsl:fork), src/xslt.c, the serializer, the result writer, the XML parser's input, include/sxml/processor.h (the byte reader) and apps/sxml/command_transform.c.

Done (): (a), (b) xsl:fork and (c); sxml transform identity on 95.6 MB 525 MB to 134 MB peak resident, accumulators more than 4.1 GB to 135 MB; XT40 12,031 to 12,048, none lost. Left: xsl:merge with streamed inputs (a new evaluator part) and (d), whose parser change waits for src/xml.c, src/xml_segment.c and src/xml_encoding.c (perf-3); the design is in .

7.6f The last streaming items (after 7.6e and perf-3; ): (a) incremental bytes as designed them: the additive resource form SXML_RESOURCE_FORM_BYTE_READER in processor.h, the incremental parse decoding its input a window at a time (UTF-16 and ISO-8859-1 too), the CLI's resolver delivering files that way, peak resident memory of sxml transform on a streamed identity before and after, the JavaScript host unchanged; (b) xsl:merge with streamed inputs, a new evaluator part reading several documents in step; (c) capture="yes" end rules while streaming, if cheap.

Owns: new src/xml_input.c; src/xml.c, src/xml_encoding.c, src/xml_internal.h, include/sxml/processor.h (the form), src/processor.c, src/evaluator_stream.c, tests/xml_test.c, the CLI's file reader and resolver.

Done 2026-10-20 (): (a) the byte reader form and the text window (src/xml_input.c); sxml transform on 95.6 MB, streamed identity 133.9 MB to 11.0 MB peak resident, for-each 134.5 MB to 11.0 MB, 974 MB in 10.9 MB; the JavaScript host unchanged (BYTES); XT40 11,918 and XQ40 45,914 passed, unchanged case by case. Left: (b) xsl:merge with streamed inputs and (c) capture="yes" end rules, designed in ; both need a new IR form or function and an evaluator part in files packet 4.21 held uncommitted (src/ir_internal.h, src/ir.c, src/ir_verify.c, src/evaluator.c, src/evaluator_machine_internal.h).

7.6g The last two streaming items (after 7.6f and 4.21; , ): (a) xsl:merge with streamed inputs, a MERGE part with one cursor per anchor document, keyed k-way stepping and XTDE2220 for input out of order, reusing the STREAM machinery, the merge key rules and the evaluator's resumable tasks; (b) capture="yes" end rules, a capture function with the stream builder copying the element's events into a full window. Keep GLOBAL_READ and the global-read pass working ().

Owns: src/evaluator_stream.c, src/xslt_lower_group.c (the merge), src/xslt_lower_stream.c, src/xslt_accumulator.c, tests/evaluator_stream_test.c; single hunks in the IR (src/ir_internal.h, src/ir.c, src/ir_verify.c, the passes), src/evaluator.c and src/xquery_prolog.c.

Done 2026-10-20 (): MERGE and its merge streams; tees for capturing end rules. Two 38.3 MB documents merged: peak resident 1,055.6 MB to 11.0 MB. XT40 11,943 to 11,945, none lost; 27 merge and 5 capture cases stream. Left: merge sources with validation, type, accumulators or predicates (grounded).
Header: possibly xslt.h, additive: a streamed principal source given as bytes or a parser, with a record. The resolver's BYTES form already serves xsl:source-document.
After: 7.6b after 7.6a.
Size: 0 in sxml.wasm; 150–250 KB in the CLI.
Gate: ≥ 85 % of the in-scope streaming cases; XT40 passes not dropped; the memory test's peak is under 64 MB.
